channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zion Williamson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zion Williamson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Borrego on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:James Borrego on #Pelicans getting two wins over Clippers with Zion Williamson scoring 14 and 15 pts:

“Z is comfortable just making the right play. There's no frustration on his part(to not get as many shots). The goal is to win... our offensive weapons are so diverse right now.”

James Borrego on Zion Williamson, Mar 21, 2026. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: David Fizdale on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Fizdale said in an interview with @RunItBackFDTV.

“...Losing all them damn games, donating my record to get Zion Williamson or Ja.”

David Fizdale on Zion Williamson, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: Derik Queen on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Derik Queen on playing with Zion Williamson for #Pelicans:

“He's a killer. I can't wait to talk to him, and excited to be his teammate. Can't wait to talk to him, pick his brain, ask him questions about the game.”

Derik Queen on Zion Williamson, Jun 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Joe Dumars:

“I read that last week (that I was given a mandate to trade Zion Williamson). If I did, nobody told me.”

Joe Dumars on Zion Williamson, Apr 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Former New Orleans center and now ESPN host Kendrick Perkins explained on the Road Trippin Podcast how the former No. 1 overall pick and the organization aren’t seeing eye to eye.

“My source tells me that they [Pelicans and Zion Williamson] are not on the same page at all,”

Kendrick Perkins on Zion Williamson, Dec 25, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Willie Green on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Willie Green on Zion Williamson being sidelined due to hamstring injury:

“He’s upset. Disappointed. No way around it. It was tough news. We are all rallying around him, and going to support him as best as we can.”

Willie Green on Zion Williamson, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Willie Green on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Pelicans coach Willie Green on Zion Williamson:

“He’s one of the best players in this league. He’s extremely talented. He’s putting the work in. I love that he’s matured before our eyes… His defensive effort is there… Having Z on the floor is a true blessing and luxury to have”

Willie Green on Zion Williamson, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Willie Green on Free throws, Zion Williamson
item.description:
Willie on Zion Williamson's lack of calls:

“It's frustrating for all of us. You feel like Zion is elite at attacking the basket and he's not getting those calls. DeRozan tonight shoots 12 free throws. Zion shoots two. That's frustrating.”

Willie Green on Free throws, Zion Williamson, Feb 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Timberwolves Anthony Edwards on Zion Williamson:

“He’s a hell of a player. Touch is crazy around the rim. Super strong, we all know. But he played great tonight. He dominated the game, first quarter to fourth quarter. They came in and kick our ass tonight”

Anthony Edwards on Zion Williamson, Jan 4, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jose Alvarado on Zion Williamson
item.description:
The Grand Theft Alvarado extraordinaire empathized with the Pelicans' foundational centerpiece.

“[Williamson's] professional, bro. I don't know how I would respond. I don't know how he can do it at that age,”

Jose Alvarado on Zion Williamson, Dec 16, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Zion Williamson
item.description:
CJ McCollum on Zion Williamson:

“You forget how impactful and dominant Z is when he’s not on the court. When he gets out there, you understand the physicality and his ability to finish around the basket. Hopefully we get a large sample size where you can watch us play together this season.”

CJ McCollum on Zion Williamson, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: David Griffin on Zion Williamson
item.description:
“I can tell you Zion Williamson has been in our gym more than he has in his entire career in the offseason,”

David Griffin on Zion Williamson, Sep 19, 2023. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Moriah Mills on Zion Williamson
item.description:
“NBA I have sex tapes of me and Zion Williamson and he also has them on his trap phone. [NBA], [Pelicans] trade him now he doesn't deserve to be in New Orleans !!! Sex tapes dropping soon,”

Moriah Mills on Zion Williamson, Jun 20, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: David Griffin on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Andrew Lopez:David Griffin on Zion Williamson:

“I think it’s a matter of all the objective metrics we can have on where he is at and how he feels lining up. And to this point they haven’t.”

David Griffin on Zion Williamson, Apr 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @_Andrew_Lopez.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Zion Williamson
item.description:
“He’s missed the last about a month with the sprained toe, and I’m told the hope is that he’s back at some point soon, but there’s still not that clarity as far as when that point will be. I think for him and Zion Williamson, it is so important this season to get a level of chemistry. … I don’t think there’s a clash on how they play, but I know there’s an importance on the season, on this roster to get both of these guys chemistry.”

Brandon Ingram on Zion Williamson, Dec 21, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Willie Green on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Willie Green on Zion Williamson's play in last night's intrasquad scrimmage:

“Z looked amazing. His strength, his speed. He dominated the scrimmage pretty much. And then he did a good job of looking for his teammates. What stood out the most was his force, more than anything.”

Willie Green on Zion Williamson, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: David Griffin on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Eliot Clough:David Griffin on the issue of building around Zion Williamson:

“He's very complicated to build to because he is literally one of one. There is nobody that has his combination of assets. ... When we were leaning into Point Zion, I think you saw a player who's already top 10 in this league.”

David Griffin on Zion Williamson, May 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: Julius Randle on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Charles Oakley to @Sirius XM NBA about Julius Randle:

“I think he’s a better version of Zion Williamson to me. Because he can do more. … I said last year, they (the Knicks) didn’t have a superstar. And now they got a superstar.”

Julius Randle on Zion Williamson, Apr 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Steven Adams on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Steven Adams on Zion Williamson after the forward's 37-15-8 game vs. 76ers:

“I know we talk about strength a lot, but that’s the least interesting thing in his game,him being a strong dude. His touch is so good, his footwork is insane.”

Steven Adams on Zion Williamson, Apr 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Karl Malone on Glen Davis, Zion Williamson
item.description:
Karl Malone:

“Guys, I love Zion Williamson. We might not ever know his full potential. There was a young man who played at LSU – [Glen] ‘Big Baby’ Davis – Big Baby made a comment about eight months ago. And he came on that show and he said ‘Hey now, guys, I’m about to get into trouble with what I’m about to say. I know everybody loves Zion and I love him too. But Zion has the same body type that I got.’ He was talking about himself. And [Davis] said, ‘If [Williamson] don’t get into shape, we’ll never know his full potential.’ And he did get heat for that. But guess what guys, he needs to be averaging 40 minutes a game. You are a 21-22-year-old kid, your ass shouldn’t be getting tired.”

Karl Malone on Glen Davis, Zion Williamson, Jan 19, 2021. Source: The Players' Tribune.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Zion Williamson
item.description:
“There were some ups and down. There were some times where it got kind of hectic there. Zion (Williamson) getting hurt in the beginning. Then the 13-game losing streak. I got hurt for a while. But all in all man, we ended up being in position to make the playoffs. That was something we wanted to do. That was one of our goals. Then the pandemic hit. Just back in the bubble, it’s been an adventure for sure.”

Jrue Holiday on Zion Williamson, Aug 11, 2020. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Alvin Gentry on Zion Williamson returning to #Pelicans for Tuesday's practice:

“He’s well-liked by teammates and likes being around his teammates. Just to have him back in the gym is a real positive, a lift in energy when he’s in the building.”

Alvin Gentry on Zion Williamson, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Derrick Favors on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:Derrick Favors on Zoom conference call with media regarding Zion Williamson:

“His body looks more toned. It looks like he definitely took advantage of the break... He looks like he's ready to play, ready to dominate again.”

Derrick Favors on Zion Williamson, Jul 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: David Griffin on Zion Williamson
item.description:
David Griffin on how Zion Williamson has looked asides his physical fitness:

“He is handling the ball really well and the shooting looks great.”

David Griffin on Zion Williamson, Jun 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Moritz Wagner on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Wagner:

“You don’t want to be the guy if Zion Williamson goes up for an alley oop slam, you don’t want to do that, blocking that shot. But at the same time, I also don’t want to lose or hurt anyone… it’s a weird dynamic. But it’s fun to be out there with those guys.”

Moritz Wagner on Zion Williamson, Feb 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Pelicans coach Alvin Gentry on rookie Zion Williamson’s knee:

“He’s doing some stuff with us in practice, but we’re taking it slow. He’s working his butt off to get back on the court. We’ll put him out there when he’s ready to play. It’s not going to be any big rush.”

Alvin Gentry on Zion Williamson, Dec 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Josh Hart on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Josh Hart on the Pelicans playing without Zion Williamson:

“It’s frustrating. We’re 0-3 and could easily be 3-0. This team is definitely going to be a playoff team.”

Josh Hart on Zion Williamson, Oct 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Zion Williamson
item.description:
Lonzo Ball on whether he’s ever seen anything similar to Zion Williamson’s incredible efficiency & impact for a rookie these last 2 preseason games:

“I haven’t seen it yet. I tell him all the time that he’s amazing. Just keep doing what he’s doing, the sky is the limit for him.”

Lonzo Ball on Zion Williamson, Oct 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Nicolo Melli on Zion Williamson
item.description:
#Pelicans power forward Nicolo Melli on frequently being matched up against Zion Williamson in practice:

“It's challenging. At 19 years old, it’s unbelievable how he can control his body, how big he is, how fast he can run, how high he can jump.”

Nicolo Melli on Zion Williamson, Oct 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: David Griffin on Alvin Gentry, Zion Williamson
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:David Griffin on how he and Alvin Gentry connected with Williamson & his family on the night of the draft lottery:

“We were so taken by Zion in the first 20 minutes that we asked for his family to join us and we spent an hour and a half.”

David Griffin on Alvin Gentry, Zion Williamson, Jun 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.
